# Sepsu Dev — Full-stack Engineer Portfolio

> Full-stack engineer with 3+ years of experience building reliable backends, cloud-native services, and fluid web applications. Based in Jakarta, Indonesia.

## Overview
Sepsu Dev is an interactive portfolio showcasing production projects, technical stacks, architecture focus areas, and case studies.

## Primary Pages & Resources
- [Home Desk](https://sepsu.dev/): Interactive workspace canvas featuring projects, live location widget, dark mode switch, and tech stack pills.
- [About](https://sepsu.dev/about): Career focus, technical skills, philosophy, and experience background.
- [Projects](https://sepsu.dev/projects): Curated list of web applications and case studies with paginated views.
- [Contact](https://sepsu.dev/contact): Get in touch for roles, projects, and collaboration inquiries.
- [Cryptix Case Study](https://sepsu.dev/project/cryptix): Next-gen crypto exchange application product design & engineering.
- [Novera Case Study](https://sepsu.dev/project/novera): AI-assisted legal contract workspace platform.
- [Pitlane Case Study](https://sepsu.dev/project/pitlane): Real-time motorsport telemetry and data visualization platform.
- [Sitemap](https://sepsu.dev/sitemap.xml): Search engine indexing sitemap.
- [Robots](https://sepsu.dev/robots.txt): Search engine crawler directives.

## Technical Architecture & Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router, Turbopack, React 19)
- **Languages**: TypeScript, PHP, Node.js
- **Backend Frameworks**: Laravel, CodeIgniter, Express.js, Nest.js
- **Databases & DevOps**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, CI/CD
- **Frontend & Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Motion, Responsive Canvas
